notes: Random MIDI driver descriptors (sometimes not type 1) with random real-mode driver info, transfer buffer, environment-variable and file-name pointers (sometimes null or empty), random I/O parameter sets from the caller (or none), the driver default and the driver's list (0..4 entries, scan flag 0, 1 or 2), random sequence counts, service rates, volume and bend range. 0x1047a4, 0x101f88, 0x1023d8, getenv 0x9c858 and 0x102144 return per-case sequences (allocation and timer failures, failed probes; a third of the cases fail every probe); 0x101f88 also fills the AX..DX result of messages 0x301/0x501. All cdecl stubs log their stack arguments and clobber EBX/ECX/EDX; 0x111c90 and getenv keep the register ABI. 0x1132b8 and the string helpers run the original code (needs --flat-segments).
